name: Rosewood AMAALA
insider_take: Where the raw splendor of the Red Sea meets visionary luxury, Rosewood AMAALA is Saudi Arabia's boldest statement in ultra-refined coastal living.
whats_special: Rosewood AMAALA sits within the extraordinary TRIPLE BAY destination on Saudi Arabia's northwestern Red Sea coastline — a giga-project designed to become the world's premier wellness and arts-focused resort community. The resort's design draws deeply from the natural landscape, with architecture that mirrors the dramatic coral-rich coastline and pristine turquoise waters of one of the world's most biodiverse marine ecosystems. As part of Saudi Vision 2030, AMAALA represents a rare chance to experience a destination before the rest of the world catches on.
pro_tip: The Red Sea surrounding AMAALA is home to some of the most untouched coral reefs on the planet. Ask the concierge to arrange a private snorkeling or diving excursion — this marine environment is genuinely world-class and shouldn't be missed.
dont_miss: Don't miss the resort's immersive wellness programming, inspired by the healing properties of the Red Sea and rooted in holistic Rosewood Sense® spa philosophy. Also keep an eye out for curated arts and cultural experiences — AMAALA's mission places creativity and culture at the heart of the destination.
pros: Pristine Red Sea access with world-class snorkeling and diving among untouched coral reefs
Ultra-luxury wellness and spa offerings aligned with AMAALA's wellness destination vision
Exquisite design blending contemporary architecture with the natural beauty of the Arabian coastline
Exclusive, intimate atmosphere with bespoke Rosewood service renowned for personalized attention
Private beach and overwater villas offering unparalleled seclusion and panoramic sea views
cons: Remote destination requiring significant travel time from major international hubs
Ultra-premium pricing positions this resort as an aspirational, bucket-list experience
Newly opened property within a developing mega-destination, with surrounding amenities still expanding
